description: This Java class 'ExtrasSheetPopulator' is responsible for creating and populating an Excel sheet named 'Extras' with data related to funds, payment types, and currencies. It uses the Apache POI library to manipulate Excel files, and it is part of the 'org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.bulkimport.populator' package within the Fineract project. The class initializes the sheet layout, sets column widths, headers, and fills in the rows with the provided data lists, then protects the sheet.
